files/work/api/mise.toml:
[tools]
hk = "2.2.0"
jq = "latest"
node = "24"
"npm:prettier" = "latest"

[env]
APP_ENV = "api"
_.file = [".env", { path = ".env.deploy", redact = true }]

[tasks.lint]
run = "node --check src/server.js"

[tasks.test]
run = "node --test --test-reporter=dot"

[tasks.build]
run = "mkdir -p dist && cp src/server.js dist/server.js"
sources = ["src/**/*.js"]
outputs = ["dist/server.js"]

[tasks.ci]
depends = ["lint", "test", "build"]
run = "echo \"api ready: node $(node --version), APP_ENV=$APP_ENV\""
files/work/shop/mise.toml:
[tools]
pitchfork = "2.27.0"

[daemons]
postgres = "18"

[daemons_settings]
namespace = "shop"

[tasks.db]
daemons = "postgres"
run = 'psql -Atc "show server_version"'
